sentences.text: Revenue went from essentially nil in FY2021 to $5.39 billion in FY2025, a 48.1% three-year CAGR from FY2022 [F3][F7][D342].
The step change was FY2022, when revenue jumped 2914.5% to $1.66 billion as deliveries began, and FY2023 added another 167.4% to $4.43 billion [F4][F5][D83][D135].
FY2022 revenue rose on increased deliveries of 19,412 vehicles, and FY2023 on 29,790 more deliveries plus higher average selling prices [P67][P56].
Growth then decelerated to 12.1% in FY2024 and 8.4% in FY2025, while the operating loss narrowed 23.5% to $3.59 billion [D187][D239][F26][D240].
In FY2025 Software and Services contributed 21.6pp of the 8.4% revenue growth, while Automotive subtracted 13.2pp [D323][D239][D316].

Software and services revenue rose 221.7% to $1.56 billion on vehicle electrical architecture and software development services for the Joint Venture, plus remarketing and repair and maintenance [D322][S26][P18].
Automotive revenue fell 14.6% to $3.83 billion as deliveries dropped 9,332 vehicles, partly from expiration of 45W tax credits, and regulatory credit sales declined [D315][S23][P22].
New electric vehicles still held 67.6% of revenue but fell 12.5%, a concentration risk in a shrinking core [D286][D287].
Operating costs grew 6.9% against 8.4% revenue growth, an incremental operating margin of 264.7% [D258][D239][D265].
Gross margin turned positive at 2.7% in FY2025, from a window median of -45.8% and low of -845.5% [F19][D332][D330].
Operating margin improved 27.8pp to -66.5%, still far below the peer median of -1.6% [D253][F31][D344].

The FY2025 bridge was almost entirely cost of revenue, +26.8pp, as Automotive cost fell on fewer vehicles, lower raw material and conversion costs, and prior-year accelerated depreciation [D267][P21].
SG&A cost 0.5pp of margin as go-to-market expansion raised payroll and stock-based compensation, while R&D added 1.5pp [D269][P13][D268].
Net margin of -67.7% tracked operating margin, with other expense of $54 million including a $186 million litigation settlement [F43][X84][P10].
Operating cash burn narrowed to $779 million in FY2025 from $1.72 billion, and free cash flow to -$2.49 billion, a -46.2% margin [F64][F63][F78][D226].
The operating improvement came primarily from a significant reduction in net loss [P4].
Capex rose 49.9% to $1.71 billion, 31.7% of revenue and 2.18x D&A, as capacity expanded at the Normal Factory [D246][F71][D225][D228][P3].
Stock-based compensation of $741 million equaled 20.7% of the operating loss, so cash burn understates the economic cost [X56][D237].
Net cash fell to $1.64 billion from $3.26 billion, as cash and investments dropped 21.0% to $6.08 billion against $4.44 billion of debt [D231][D179][D261][D229][D230].
Net cash was 30.5% of revenue, above the peer median of 17.8% and the 75th percentile of four peers [D232][D352][D351].
The current ratio fell to 2.33x, its window low, from a 4.94x median, as current liabilities grew 64.1% [F129][D339][D341][D251].
Financing raised $886 million, mainly $750 million of stock issued to Volkswagen Group, and the diluted share count rose 17.1% [F92][P2][D260].
The company has posted a net loss in each of the last seven years, including $3.65 billion in FY2025 [R1][F38].
Stock-based compensation was 13.8% of revenue in FY2025 and at least 10% in each of the last five years, persistent dilution pressure [R2][D223].
Cash and investments cover only 2.4 years of the latest burn, down from 2.7 years [R3][D236][D184].
The core New electric vehicles line was 67.6% of revenue and fell 12.5% in FY2025 [R4][D286][D287].
Product revenue members sum to 129% of consolidated revenue in FY2025, so segment figures overlap and should not be added [R6].
Whether gross margin holds above the FY2025 level of 2.7% in the FY2026 10-K would confirm the cost-per-vehicle trend [F19].
Whether operating margin improves past -66.5% or slips back toward the -129.4% window median will show if leverage persists [F31][D326].
Whether net cash stays above the FY2025 level of $1.64 billion, or burn outruns it, is the liquidity test [D231].
